section_summary.extract_value: This section details the experimental procedure conducted in a computer laboratory with groups of up to 10 participants. The session, lasting approximately 2.5 hours, involved participants completing a sociodemographic questionnaire, motivation scales, the INSBAT (an intelligence test), a speed of information processing task, tasks of creative potential, a creative achievement questionnaire (CAQ), and the BFSI personality inventory. The study was approved by the University of Graz Ethics Committee. No specific study numbers or multiple sample subsets are mentioned.
